scope: User-authorized isolated Windows official-source host ghc-pkg build; no production source or profile changes

ownership.owner: LocalCoder Gate B isolated ghc-pkg source-build probe, 2026-09-09
ownership.cleanupPolicy: Do not remove the owned root until Task 2 has finished using the matching tool and its retained provenance. Remove only this exact root when authorized cleanup is appropriate.

handoff.globalDatabase: matched/stage1/lib/package.conf.d is a fresh EMPTY database initialized by this matching executable, not a copied bootstrap database
handoff.layoutReason: Official generated stage0 settings direct the global package database to ../../stage1/lib/package.conf.d. Preserve this layout; merely copying the executable to an arbitrary bin directory is insufficient.
handoff.environment: Native Windows executable; verified with PATH=C:\Windows\System32, without GHC, MSYS, cabal or WASI SDK on PATH. Clear inherited GHC_PACKAGE_PATH for deterministic DB selection. Use --no-user-package-db for profile operations.
handoff.runtimeDependencies: Only Windows system DLLs/UCRT, enumerated in retained evidence-index.json; no GHC or MSYS DLL is imported
handoff.targetCompilerPaths: Official default.target retains absolute paths to the isolated WASI SDK. ghc-pkg recache/check do not invoke those compilers. The SDK remains in the owned root for provenance and subsequent diagnostic use.
handoff.prohibitedUse: Do not use any probe or bootstrap package.cache as the profile cache; Task 2 must invoke this executable to recache its own staged package descriptions. No full libdir browser fallback was created.

officialSourceAssociation.versionRule: Official m4/fp_setup_project_version.m4 appends the UTC last-commit date for development versions and explicitly accepts VERSION_DATE and GIT_COMMIT_ID for archive source trees. Those two archive metadata inputs were supplied from the official commit response. No version module or tool banner was handwritten or modified.

gateACompiler.meaning: The exact locked commit string is present in the hash-verified Gate A compiler, in addition to the official commit/date/version-rule association. This is not a new browser startup receipt.

cabalSubmodule.usedForProducedGhcPkg: Matching in-tree Cabal and Cabal-syntax sources; NOT the same-version installed libraries

sourceVerification.details: Every checked file's upstream blob identity and actual SHA-256 are in evidence-index.json/sourceChecks. Submodule archive URLs use the exact gitlinks in the official locked GHC tree.

primaryDownloads.verification: HTTPS official source archive plus relevant source files verified against official commit Git blob identities
GHC's official gitlink and official Cabal source blob comparison

primaryDownloads.installation: Archive extraction into owned root/msys64; pacman-key --init and --populate msys2, followed by signed official repository packages. No system-wide installer was used.

primaryDownloads.purpose: Official target compiler/sysroot necessary for authentic wasm32-wasi configure/ghc-toolchain probes, not a replacement GHC

additionalSources.submoduleSourceAndHashLedger: evidence-index.json/events, kind=download; source-tree.json records exact locked gitlinks
additionalSources.hackage: https://hackage.haskell.org/ using Cabal secure repository metadata; Hadrian's official cabal.project pins index-state 2025-12-19T19:24:24Z. Complete build plan including source hashes is embedded in evidence-index.json/hackagePlan.
additionalSources.msys: Official MSYS repositories with normal signature checking enabled. Installed package/version list and each cached package archive SHA-256 are embedded in evidence-index.json.
additionalSources.isolatedCabalConfig: cabal/config in owned root explicitly sets repository cache, store, logs and world file inside owned root; process CABAL_DIR/CABAL_CONFIG/STACK_ROOT also point inside owned root

build.ghcupShimNote: The small bin/cabal.exe is a shim. The actual cabal-3.14.2.0.exe was separately hashed. Bootstrap ghc-pkg was used ONLY for the official Hadrian host bootstrap DB, never as the profile-cache producer.

dependencySetup.command: msys64/usr/bin/pacman.exe -Sy --noconfirm --needed autoconf automake make python perl patch

finalBuild.bootstrapLibraryContract: Official Hadrian generated ghc-boot-9.15 and ghc-boot-th-next-9.15 using ProjectVersionMunged, while generated GHC.Version exposes full 9.15.20260202. No fabricated date-version package metadata was used. Host ghc-internal was provided by the bootstrap compiler as prescribed by stage0, rather than pretending it was a target library.

build.sourceEdits: Only VERSION_DATE and GIT_COMMIT_ID archive metadata inputs; all retained GHC/Hadrian/cache-serialization source comparisons passed. No source patch, banner patch, handwritten GHC.Version/GHC.Platform.Host/settings/default.target, or cache copying.

GHC.Platform.Host.note: Correct HOST of native executable; target is read separately from default.target

generatedConfiguration.fullContents: evidence-index.json/generated contains complete generated files, including ghc-boot and ghc-boot-th-next package metadata

verification.userHomeAppdataXdgTemp: All explicitly isolated to owned root; no inherited GHC_PACKAGE_PATH

completeEvidence.contents: Complete ordered command argv/cwd/exit/PID/timing ledger, download URLs/actual hashes, all successful final tool outputs, complete generated configurations, source blob checks, tool hashes, DLL imports, signed MSYS package inventory and hashes, and Hackage build plan. Full compiler logs remain alongside the index with hashes. Failed and superseded attempts are retained, not represented as passing.
completeEvidence.retention: Evidence and owned root are retained for the parent. This repository JSON is the formal summary and binding to the full external build evidence, not a browser or full Gate B receipt.
